title: Passive Subdomain Discovery (Exclude www)
purpose: Passively enumerate indexed subdomains of a target root domain without sending DNS queries to target authoritative servers.

title: Publicly Indexed Office & PDF Documents
query: site:example.com (ext:pdf OR ext:docx OR ext:xlsx OR ext:pptx OR ext:csv)
purpose: Harvest public documents to extract author usernames, internal software versions, printer names, and internal paths via ExifTool.

title: Exposed Environment & Config Files
query: site:example.com (ext:env OR ext:yaml OR ext:yml OR ext:ini OR ext:conf OR ext:sql) ("DB_PASSWORD" OR "API_KEY" OR "SECRET")
purpose: Identify accidentally indexed configuration files and SQL dumps on web servers.

title: Apache/Nginx Open Directory Listings
query: site:example.com intitle:"index of /" ("parent directory" OR "backup" OR "uploads" OR ".git")
purpose: Locate browsable web server directory listings exposing backups, raw media, or `.git` folders.

title: Indexed AWS S3, Azure Blob & GCS Buckets
purpose: Discover public cloud object storage buckets referencing a company, brand, or project slug.

title: Passive Telegram Channel & Invite Link Discovery
purpose: Find public Telegram handles and private invite links indexed across the web without logging into Telegram.

title: Telegram Web Preview Post Search
purpose: Search inside public Telegram channel web previews (`t.me/s/`) for exact phrases, handles, or wallet addresses.

title: Discord Server Invite Discovery
purpose: Surface public Discord invite codes mentioning a brand, game, group, or threat keyword.

title: Public WhatsApp Group Invite Links
purpose: Discover indexed WhatsApp group invite URLs shared on forums, social bios, or websites.

title: Public Trello Boards & Notion Workspaces
purpose: Uncover public project roadmaps, onboarding docs, or contractor boards accidentally set to public.

title: Exposed Google Docs, Sheets & Drive Folders
purpose: Locate publicly shared spreadsheets, rosters, and Drive folders tied to an event or organization.

title: LinkedIn Employee & Role X-Ray Search
purpose: Enumerate company personnel and organizational structure without triggering LinkedIn's 'Who Viewed Your Profile' alerts.

title: Paste & Code Snippet Leak Sweep
query: (site:pastebin.com OR site:ghostbin.co OR site:rentry.co OR site:gist.github.com) "@example.com"
purpose: Search major paste and snippet hosts for leaked corporate email addresses or domains.

title: Exposed Swagger / OpenAPI Documentation
query: site:example.com (inurl:/swagger-ui OR inurl:/api-docs OR inurl:/openapi.json OR intitle:"Swagger UI")
purpose: Identify self-documented REST/GraphQL endpoints and internal API schemas.

title: Public Jira Dashboards & Confluence Wikis
purpose: Find unauthenticated Atlassian Confluence spaces and Jira issue trackers.

title: Origin Servers via TLS Certificate Subject/CN
purpose: Bypass CDN proxies by finding direct origin IPv4/IPv6 hosts presenting a TLS certificate for the target domain.

title: Favicon MurmurHash3 (`mmh3`) Pivot
purpose: Locate all internet-facing servers sharing an identical web application or brand favicon hash (e.g., Spring Boot, Cobalt Strike, or custom company icon).

title: Unauthenticated Elasticsearch & MongoDB Instances
purpose: Audit an organization's netblocks for exposed, unauthenticated NoSQL/search clusters.

title: Unauthenticated RTSP Streams with Screenshots
purpose: Filter Shodan's pre-captured visual screenshots on RTSP port 554 within a geographic area.

title: Exposed Industrial Control Systems (Modbus / S7 / BACnet)
query: tag:"ics" (port:502 OR port:102 OR port:47808) asn:"AS12345"
purpose: Passively check an ASN for internet-exposed SCADA/ICS industrial protocols.

title: TLS JARM Fingerprint Pivot
purpose: Hunt servers sharing an identical active TLS stack JARM fingerprint.

title: Assets Flagged with Known CVEs in Netblock
purpose: Identify hosts in an owned CIDR range with banner-inferred CVEs (requires Shodan Academic/Small Business+).

title: Suspected C2 Malleable Profile Indicators
purpose: Track default or recycled adversary C2 certificates and beacon listeners.

title: Hosts Presenting Target Domain in TLS Leaf Cert
purpose: Discover non-CDN hosts terminating TLS for `example.com` across all 65,535 scanned ports.

title: HTTP HTML Title & Body Hash Pivot
purpose: Find matching login portals or clone pages across global IPv4/IPv6 hosts.

title: C2 Server Hunt via JARM + Non-Standard Port
purpose: Combine JARM TLS stack fingerprinting with uncommon port filtering to isolate C2 servers.

title: HTTP Open Directory Servers on Non-Standard Ports
purpose: Locate exposed directory listings hosted inside a specific cloud or ISP ASN.

title: FOFA Favicon Hash & Domain Asset Search
purpose: Correlate domain, TLS certificate, and favicon hash matches in FOFA's cyberspace index.

title: Brand Login Clone / Phishing Kit Hunt
purpose: Detect external phishing servers cloning your organization's SSO login title.

title: Hardcoded Tokens & Private Keys Linked to Domain
query: "example.com" ("BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY" OR "BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY" OR "AKIA" OR "ghp_" OR "xoxb-")
purpose: Hunt leaked AWS keys, Slack bot tokens, GitHub PATs, and SSH private keys referencing a target domain.

title: Committed `.env` & Docker Compose Credentials
purpose: Find production environment files and container configs mentioning internal domains.

title: Internal & Staging Hostnames in Public Code
purpose: Discover non-public staging, VPN, and intranet FQDNs leaked by developers or contractors.

title: Commits Authored by Corporate Email Domain
purpose: Identify personal GitHub accounts and side projects of employees committing with work email configs.

title: Pivot Across Identical Page / Resource SHA-256 Hash
purpose: Find every scanned webpage loading the exact same JavaScript skimmer, logo, or phishing kit resource.

title: Reverse Domain Search by Page Domain & IP ASN
purpose: Inspect historical DOM snapshots, outbound XHR requests, and HTTP redirect chains for a domain.

title: Historical Backup, Config & Archive URLs via CDX
purpose: Query the Internet Archive CDX API directly for archived backups, configs, and JSON endpoints across all subdomains.

title: Exposed Firebase Realtime Databases
purpose: Discover mobile/web app Firebase Realtime Database endpoints indexed by Google (append `/.json` in authorized tests).

title: Public Supabase Project Endpoints in Client Bundles
purpose: Identify exposed PostgREST Supabase project URLs referenced alongside a target domain.

title: Public Postman Collections & Environments
purpose: Surface developer Postman API workspaces indexed in Google.

title: Publicly Shared Cloud Meeting Recordings
purpose: Locate publicly shared Loom walkthroughs or Zoom recordings discussing internal systems.

title: Bio-Link Aggregator Handle Discovery
query: (site:linktr.ee OR site:beacons.ai OR site:carrd.co OR site:solo.to) "target_handle"
purpose: Uncover multi-platform bio-link trees linking a persona's secondary social, payment, and shop accounts.

title: Court Filings, Affidavits & Indictment PDFs
query: ext:pdf ("United States District Court" OR "Affidavit" OR "Indictment" OR "Case No.") "Target Name"
purpose: Surface unindexed legal exhibits, criminal complaints, and civil affidavits hosted on law blogs or court mirrors.

title: Off-Chain Wallet Address Attribution Sweep
purpose: Exclude noisy block explorers so Google surfaces forum signatures, GitHub READMEs, or social bios where the owner posted their wallet.

title: Indexed Hugging Face Spaces & Datasets
purpose: Find public ML demos, datasets, and Gradio/Streamlit Spaces referencing corporate domains.

title: Unauthenticated Prometheus Metrics & Grafana Dashboards
query: (http.title:"Prometheus Time Series" port:9090) OR (http.title:"Grafana" "Anonymous") org:"Target Corp"
purpose: Passively check Shodan for exposed observability dashboards leaking internal hostname topologies.

title: Exposed Kubernetes API / Kubelet / etcd Ports
query: (port:6443 OR port:10250 OR port:2379) ssl:"kubernetes" asn:"AS12345"
purpose: Identify internet-reachable Kubernetes control-plane and etcd banners inside a target ASN.

title: Unauthenticated Internet-Exposed Ollama / vLLM Inference Servers
purpose: Detect shadow-AI local LLM inference servers accidentally bound to `0.0.0.0:11434`.

title: Starlink Satellite Terminal ASN & Dish Routers
purpose: Identify services hosted behind SpaceX Starlink (`AS14593`) satellite terminals in a country.

title: Self-Hosted MinIO & S3 XML Bucket Listings
purpose: Find self-hosted MinIO/Ceph object stores returning unauthenticated S3 XML directory listings.

title: Clearnet Servers Advertising `Onion-Location` HTTP Header
purpose: Link `.onion` hidden services directly to clearnet servers advertising official `Onion-Location` headers.

title: ZoomEye Favicon Hash & SSL Organization Match
purpose: Pivot across matching application favicons and SSL certificate Common Names in ZoomEye.

title: Leaked `terraform.tfstate` Infrastructure State Files
purpose: Discover accidentally committed Terraform state JSON files revealing complete cloud architecture and secrets.

title: Exposed Kubernetes `kubeconfig` Certificates & Tokens
purpose: Audit GitHub for leaked Kubernetes cluster admin configuration files referencing corporate domains.

title: Exposed `.npmrc` and `.pypirc` Registry Publish Tokens
purpose: Check for leaked package-registry authentication tokens tied to an organization.

title: Eyewitness Video/Photo Geocode + Exact UTC Window
purpose: Isolate original eyewitness photos/videos posted near incident coordinates within a tight UTC time window.

title: Direct PostgreSQL Query against `crt.sh:5432`
query: psql -h crt.sh -p 5432 -U guest certwatch -c "SELECT DISTINCT ci.NAME_VALUE FROM certificate_identity ci WHERE ci.NAME_TYPE = 'dNSName' AND reverse(lower(ci.NAME_VALUE)) LIKE reverse(lower('%.example.com'));"
purpose: Bypass web timeouts on massive domains by querying Sectigo's public read-only `certwatch` Postgres replica directly!
